headline: This Weekend
in Three Village
dek: Halloween is next Saturday, and the fun starts now: a free Halloween Family Fun Day at the Long Island Museum, a trunk or treat in East Setauket, Port Jeff's Chowder Crawl and the last weekend to vote for Stony Brook Village's scarecrows. Here's everything worth doing in Three Village this week, updated live.

hero.credit: Halloween Family Fun Day. Photo: The Long Island Museum
hero.alt: Two kids in police officer and ladybug costumes at the Long Island Museum's Halloween Family Fun Day

limehof.name: LI Music & Entertainment Hall of Fame

events.title: Three Village Farmers & Artisans Market
events.desc: Farmers, bakers and makers on the historical society lawn, Fridays 3 to 6 PM. Only two markets left this season: today and Oct. 30.

events.title: Spooktacular Trunk or Treat & Vendor Fair
events.desc: Trunk or treat at Messiah Lutheran Church with local craft vendors, candy, games, prizes and free face painting. Come in costume. Rain or shine (indoors if it rains).

events.title: Port Jefferson Chowder Crawl
events.desc: The Greater Port Jefferson Chamber's Chowder Crawl: 12 village restaurants serve up their chowder, and you vote for your favorite.

events.title: Trunk or Treat at Brightview
events.desc: An afternoon of Halloween fun with festive treats, decorated trunks and a costume contest. RSVP with Brightview.

events.title: Halloween Family Fun Day at the Long Island Museum
events.desc: Come in costume for pumpkin painting, festive crafts, the galleries and a Mad Science show. Bring a non-perishable food donation for Agape Meals for Kids.

events.title: Halloween Cat Arrangement Workshop
events.desc: Make a cat-themed Halloween floral arrangement at Village Florist & Events. Call 631-467-0385 to reserve.

events.title: Last Charge of the Light Horse at the Hall of Fame
events.price: Free with admission, or $10 at the door
events.desc: A Sunday concert at the Long Island Music & Entertainment Hall of Fame. Free with a general admission ticket, or $10 concert-only tickets the day of the show.

allweekend.title: Stony Brook Village Scarecrows
allweekend.when: Last weekend to vote, through Oct. 25
allweekend.desc: The 36th annual scarecrows line Stony Brook Village. Grab a ballot in any shop and vote for your favorite by Sunday; winners are announced at the Halloween Festival on Oct. 31.

allweekend.title: Spooky Village at Olde Towne Gardens
allweekend.desc: A family Halloween village at a garden center that's been in East Setauket since 1949: Gourdvilla the Pumpkin Queen's Spooky Walk, a pumpkin slide, ghost bounce house, games and a pumpkin patch.

allweekend.title: Cabaret
allweekend.desc: Theatre Three's mainstage run of the Kander and Ebb classic closes Sunday.

allweekend.title: Elephant & Piggie's We Are in a Play!
allweekend.desc: Mo Willems' best friends in a musical made for first-time theatergoers.

next.title: 36th Annual Halloween Festival in Stony Brook Village
next.desc: Free trick-or-treating through Stony Brook Village Center from noon to 4 PM, with music, games for kids, photos with Monster Merlin and the scarecrow winners announced at 2 PM.
